:::{#def-score-equation}
#### Score equation

The **score equation**
is the equation that sets the [score function](#def-score) to zero:

$$
\score(\vparam) = \vzero
$$
:::

::: notes
The score equation is one example of an **estimating equation**,
an equation whose solution defines an estimator.
Estimating equations in general need not come from a likelihood.
:::
